title: Clean Foundation and Concealer Spot Check Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A brush with a pointed tip for targeted coverage just where you need it—the ideal companion to the Vital Skin Foundation Stick (sold separately).

What Else You Need to Know: Luxurious and durable, each brush is handmade in Japan by the most prestigious brush maker in the world, using cruelty-free, super-soft nylon fibers and sustainably sourced birch. Thoughtfully designed shorter handles make for an easy, effortless application.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Dip the brush into the Vital Skin Foundation Stick (sold separately) and dab anywhere you need detailed coverage.
-Stipple to layer coverage.

Gucci Westman's tip:
-"Ideal for concealing spots, little imperfections, and to clean up after applying a bold lip color."—Gucci Westman, Westman Atelier founder
